thesis: Ben Horowitz argues that most management books are ineffective because they present situational and emotional leadership challenges as simple, step-by-step cookbooks that fail to account for the unique feelings and realities of specific moments. He illustrates this by comparing management to playing NFL quarterback, noting that reading a playbook twenty times does not prepare a leader for the visceral experience of a 290-pound player running at them.
